sample_contract: same fixed outcome-blind legal candidate order for all variants
fast100_continue_gate: at least +5 percentage points Top1 versus reference AND proper scores / Total RPS do not worsen materially

v6264_pure_market_1x2.reason: proper scores improved but 1X2 Top1 lost 5 percentage points versus formal; first layer cannot equal raw market marginal

v6265_equal_log_pool.reason: recovers 4 of 5 Top1 points lost by market-only while improving both proper scores and downstream total/score versus formal

v6266_online_hedge.reason: same 1X2 Top1 as equal log pool but slightly worse 1X2 proper scores; score Top3 improvement alone does not override first-layer priority

v6267_priorseason_scalar_residual.reason: prior-season logloss optimization collapses alpha toward market in most domains and does not recover Top1 accuracy; one global scalar cannot represent conditional residual value

v6268_priorseason_conditional_gate.reason: conditional disagreement rule recovers only to 55% and is inferior to equal log pool on 1X2 proper scores; fails the pre-declared Fast100 +5pp continuation gate

architecture_adjudication.next_1x2_method: parsimonious direct multinomial market-residual head: market logits as offset plus formal-vs-market log-odds residual features; competition-specific, trained only on strictly prior seasons; no test-set hyperparameter tuning
architecture_adjudication.stop_rule: if the direct residual head also fails the Fast100 gate, stop 1X2 fusion experimentation and retain the better of formal or equal-log-pool as research baseline pending genuinely new information/features

promotion.reason: random100 is diagnostic only and historical market quotes lack original timestamps; no CURRENT upgrade
promotion.required: strict chronological head validation plus final-system OOF/forward evidence
